numerical_manifest.reason: One automatic-SDPA FP32 sampler/scorer check failed on a trained DPO checkpoint. FP64 teacher forcing and autoregression agreed to 8.53e-14 nats on the worst rows. Native math SDPA passed the original FP32 tolerance and reproduced all 10,000 original draws on that checkpoint. All policies are revalidated uniformly; no original records are reused.

tolerances.tolerance_note: cached_vs_full_parity gates LOGITS and GRADIENTS (measured 6.20e-6 and 3.43e-6 on the pinned weights). The sum-log-probability pair gates SCORE comparisons -- sampler vs scorer, cached vs full, batch 16 vs 256 -- whose measured native fp32 worst cases are 2.38e-5, 3.34e-5 and 2.07e-5.

selection_freeze.disclosure: frozen before any reserved test label or assay outcome was read in this workflow. Aggregate integrity checks and two printed example rows per split were performed during the 2026-09-18 audit and are disclosed there; this is not a claim that the splits were sealed from the start.
